horoscope: Yesterday, Venus began its transit of your partnership sector, dear Aries, and will continue to influence this area of your chart until September 10th, and then again from October 25th to December 4th. This is a much longer period than Venus’ usual transit of a sign, which is around one month, due to an upcoming retrograde which will have the effect of extending the transit. During this cycle, you tend to attract warm, helpful people into your life. Partnerships and situations involving one-on-one contact can thrive at this time. It’s a period of more joy experienced through others. If you can benefit from making peace with someone or from getting advice or counseling, this is a strong time to do so. This transit boosts your ability to get along with others, negotiate, and collaborate. It's an excellent time to pair up in some way. Today's transits are good for finding interesting things to do and learn. Pacing yourself seems to be your best bet, and some indecision is likely.

Venus is now visiting your work and health sector, dear Taurus, where she will stay until September 10th, and then return for a bit longer stay from October 25th to December 4th. You'll enjoy more benefits in the areas of work, health, daily routines, and self-care programs during these periods. Seek ways to bring more peace and warmth, as well as balance and beauty, to your life in small but important ways during this extended stay. This can include improving your relationship with co-workers, developing rapport with people you meet while working towards health and work goals, meeting friends through your chores or business, beautifying or organizing your work environment, and so forth. There could be more positive experiences with health care workers or new ideas for supporting health. You are likely to find quite a bit of joy in the services you provide. Today's feelings can be somewhat complicated, as part of you is holding back. The second half of the day promises more ease and acceptance. Simplifying becomes far easier to do, and you might come to a better understanding with someone that helps you feel more productive and less distracted.

Venus, the goddess of love, is now transiting your romance and pleasure sector, dear Gemini, promising more smoothness and joy with creative work, recreation, and possibly romance. Venus will influence this area of your chart until September 10th, then return for a slightly longer stay from October 25th to December 4th. Love, pleasure, and charm are natural and flowing now. This can be a good time for fertility or a more playful approach to your life. You are more confident about sharing yourself and your creativity with others. Generally speaking, it’s a good time for dating. It's one of the best times of the year for enjoying hobbies, leisure activities, love, and entertainment. Your powers of attraction run high. While there may be some indecision early today, the day progresses with good energy for a creative escape. The Moon enters your sign early today, amping up your feelings and the need to express them creatively.

Venus is now transiting your solar fourth house, dear Cancer, and will continue to influence this area of your solar chart until September 10th, then returning from October 25th to December 4th. This is a longer transit than usual. It puts you in a better position to improve your home and family life, as well as your relationship with yourself. You are particularly valuing familiar people and things. Making your home or base of operations more comfortable or beautiful can be a strong focus now. You could be spending more time at home. Enhancing or repairing relationships with loved ones are favored during this cycle. Venus here stirs your desire for more harmony and balance in your personal life. It's a fine time for decorating, hosting, entertaining, and family activities. Today's energies are a little standoffish early on. However, as the day progresses, a gentle pace comes more naturally. You're in a great position to find creative ways to meet all of your needs without putting pressure on yourself. The Moon moves into your solar twelfth house for a couple of days, putting the focus on winding down, recuperating, and healing.

Venus is now transiting your communications sector, dear Leo, and will continue to move through this part of your solar chart until September 10th. Venus will return to this sector shortly after for a bit longer, from October 25th to December 4th. You can enjoy improved verbal rapport with others, easier studies, more motivation to pursue your personal interests, and joy in your daily affairs. You might even connect with someone romantically this way. Benefits may come through siblings or short trips. Venus in this area of your solar chart brings graciousness, the power of attraction, an urge to interact, and great charm. The solar third house rules communications and connections, and this transit refines, improves, and enhances your abilities to socialize, learn, communicate, and make connections. There could be purchases made or gifts received that help you to connect and learn. You are more charming and creative with your words, and love can be particularly mental and verbal during this cycle. You are drawn to things that improve your mind.

With Venus now in your solar second house, dear Virgo, you’re in a good position to enjoy a more comfortable pace, to improve your financial situation, and to enjoy working on building talents and resources. This cycle lasts until September 10th, and then returns for a bit longer from October 25th to December 4th. Love needs tend to be simpler, and you may be craving easier, more straightforward pleasures and feelings. This is a strong time to find more pleasure in the world of the five senses, enjoy simple pastimes and entertainment, and take special care of prized personal possessions. There can be increased income or special gifts and pleasures in the weeks ahead. This transit increases your desire for comfort and security as you focus on what you have around you, and at times, what you don't have. Today, you could feel somewhat dissatisfied with the status quo, particularly related to your life experiences and time set aside for learning and living, but the second half of the day is smoother. The Moon moves to the top of your solar chart early today, and you're focusing on responsibilities and goals. You're in a good position to get into a healthy pattern of productivity.

Venus has "emerged" in your solar chart, dear Libra. The goddess of love, your planetary ruler, is now in your sign and will remain until September 10th (and will return from October 25th to December 4th). This is a time to attract positive attention and to focus more on affection, love, and pleasure. You are living well and putting the right kind of vibes “out there”. You may not be as assertive as you typically are, as this position tends to bring out the diplomat and charmer in you, but you are also taking care of yourself. You are projecting warm, approachable energy now. Be good to yourself, as this is the time to reward yourself for recent efforts. Today, the Moon moves into your spirit sector for a couple of days, and this helps you rise above problems to let your spirit soar. Feelings are complicated, but you're in great shape for talking them through.

Venus is now transiting your solar twelfth house, dear Scorpio, and will continue to do so until September 10th, then returning for another stay from October 25th to December 4th. This is a house of “endings,” signaling a time to process recent events, decide what to let go of and what you need to keep, particularly regarding your affections. You might crave and enjoy private time, and certainly can benefit from it. It’s an excellent period for reflection and sorting out your feelings. You may be doing a lot for others now, or spending more time to yourself, and your personal visibility is lower than usual, even with more professional or public attention recently. The Moon heads into your intimacy sector for a couple of days, and you'll demand a little more from your activities or relationships as you seek more depth, substance, or involvement. It's a good time for better cooperation with family or loved ones.

Venus has begun its transit of your friendship and goals sector, dear Sagittarius, and will continue to affect this area of your solar chart until September 10th, returning later from October 25th to December 4th. This is a good time for appreciating friends and networks, as well as their appreciation of you! There can be mutual benefits with friends, and a nice sense that you can be yourself with others and feel at ease. Be gracious with business associates, as this is a good time for making connections, and consider long-term happiness goals during this cycle. You'll better understand the benefits of relaxing and taking some time off from responsibilities. It's time to give special attention to your humanitarian impulses and happiness goals. Today, try not to add to your pile, since feeling overwhelmed is counterproductive. As the day advances, you can feel especially connected to someone or excited and motivated by a personal interest.

Venus has begun its transit of your reputation and profession sector, dear Capricorn, where it will influence until September 10th, and then again from October 25th to December 4th. Social or love matters can be associated with your work, or could be a little more public now. You are received especially well in a professional capacity, or you're more appreciated for your efforts and performance. You are also more aware of how you’re coming across, and tend to do a little more choosing of your words more carefully than you normally would. Others are willing to assist you with your goals. You might make especially important connections and contacts. You may be calling the shots now or enjoying opportunities, promotions, or advances. Today, you could have some questions about commitment, whether to a person, idea, or project, and you may feel temporarily overwhelmed. However, the day advances with more smoothness. It can be a good time for dreaming up plans and ideas. The Moon's move into your work and health sector early today for a stay of over two days suggests you'll want to get busy with organizing.

Venus is now transiting your solar ninth house, dear Aquarius, and is moving in harmony with your sign. Venus will continue to influence this area of your chart until September 10th, and then again from October 25th to December 4th. During this cycle, your feelings are easier to express and understand, and when it comes to love, your ideals are high. There is a greater need for mental rapport, and people who love to learn and/or awaken your spirit tend to be most attractive to you now. There could be a pleasurable trip or an adventure that takes you out of your routine. You are less likely to overthink things and tend to gravitate towards social or romantic situations that make you happy. Promotional efforts can thrive now, and so can publishing or reaching out to a broader audience. Intuition improves. While feelings today can be complicated, and indecision can disrupt the flow in spots, you are likely to feel far more comfortable in your own skin as the day advances. It's easier to interact in a healthy way when you feel more centered and on top of things.

Venus is now transiting an intimate sector of your solar chart, dear Pisces, and will continue to influence this sector until September 10th (and will return for a bit longer stay, from October 25th to December 4th). It can be fun to figure things out, research, investigate, analyze, or get to know yourself, looking for clues and hidden aspects. Intimate relationships can be more enjoyable. It’s also a good time to attract support, emotional or financial, and to iron out problems related to money and difficult power dynamics in relationships. You are looking for deep, intense, and rich experiences with others. Even complications are attractive on some level now. You might want to watch for overthinking on this level, however. Feelings of love and attachment intensify during this cycle. Today, the Moon moves into your home and family sector for a stay of a couple of days, and this transit reminds you to slow down and pay more attention to what your heart needs.
